dialogues.speaker: Zinaida
dialogues.text: Strange... Things are eerily calm around here. It's precisely at times like this that you've got to stay alert...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Zinaida
dialogues.text: As you can see, I'm waiting for a commission, of course. If it's all the same to you, please don't block my view.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems I shouldn't interrupt...

dialogues.speaker: Zinaida
dialogues.text: Hmm, you don't seem suspicious. Maybe I'm too antsy...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As it happens, I have a commission for you...

dialogues.speaker: Zinaida
dialogues.text: Hmm? Well, sorry, but I don't take such trivial tasks. Find someone else and leave me alone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you staring over there?

dialogues.speaker: Zinaida
dialogues.text: Am I? Well, maybe it's because "over there" looks nicer.

dialogues.speaker: Zinaida
dialogues.text: Aside from that, guess there's nothing of note around here for you. Shoo.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Zinaida
dialogues.text: ...Lady Nefer.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: It's been a while, Ms. Zinaida. I trust the guild's commission hasn't given you too much trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Zinaida
dialogues.text: With your kind concern, it's been going smoothly enough. Few would dare strike at the port supervisor in broad daylight... and if they did, I'd see to it before that young master even noticed.

dialogues.speaker: Zinaida
dialogues.text: Protecting some, removing others... not so different from before. But at least I'm not stuck protecting a blood-soaked bandit chief this time.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I see. Glad to hear it.

dialogues.speaker: Zinaida
dialogues.text: By the way, Lady Nefer...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Jahoda's doing well, there's no need to worry. If you have something to say to her, feel free to tell her yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Zinaida
dialogues.text: ...No, it's not that I'm worried about her, and she doesn't need me to fret over her either. As for what needed to be said, I've already said it all.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Everything that needs to be said, indeed... But what about the things you want to say?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: If you want to see Jahoda, the Curatorium of Secrets is always open to you.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Some things can only be said in person, or they'll go unnoticed like fine gravel sinking into quicksand, leaving only regret behind.

dialogues.speaker: Zinaida
dialogues.text: ...I know. Thank you for the advice. For now... It's best as it is, both for her and for me.
